bibl.title: The Oases of Egypt's Western Desert from Byzantine to Islamic Rule: Problems and New Perspectives.
bibl.seg: Nicoletta De Troia, The Oases of Egypt's Western Desert from Byzantine to Islamic Rule: Problems and New Perspectives.
Journal of Late Antiquity 15 (2022) pp. 277-303, figg.
bibl.note: Introduction. - From Byzantine to Islamic Egypt: change and continuity. - A slow transformation. - The oases in the Late Roman and Byzantine periods. - The oasite districts. - Life in the oases: a glimpse. - The oases and the Mazices people. - The Western Desert oases from the Arab conquest to the Fatimids: First attestations; - The land of oases and Its subdivisions; - The land of oases and Egypt. - Conclusions.
